name: Ribbonweed
desc: A seagrass whose meadows in Shark Bay include one giant clone covering about 200 square km. Rhizomes anchor the sand and the leaves slow silt.
about: Posidonia australis, also known as strapweed, tapeweed, ribbonweed or fibre-ball weed, is a species of seagrass that occurs in the southern coastal waters of Australia.
